audience: Self-taught musicians who want ear training in musical context rather than isolated interval drills.
job_to_be_done: Practice hearing scale degrees, voice-led progressions, and sung pitches at a self-directed pace, without creating an account or uploading audio.
core_experience: Live monophonic sung-pitch feedback on a two-octave keyboard
Sandbox exploration, test-mode scheduling, and a hold-level control
constraints: Microphone audio is analysed in the browser and never recorded or uploaded
No analytics, third-party fonts, or remote application scripts
Core practice and CSV export remain free and accessible
Optional Studio is a $24 one-time Sociobot/Dodo license unlock
